annotation.summary_en: Three friends try to break one's arm to help him dodge the draft by scaring him with nonsensical army dilemmas, only for a butcher to intervene.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: A young man, Artyomik, is distraught about his upcoming military service call the next morning. His friends sit with him on a couch in a living room, terrorizing him with absurd 'catch-22' scenarios about army life: if he sweeps the floor he breaks, if he doesn't sweep he gets beaten until he breaks; if he drops a cigarette he betrays his friends, if he doesn't he isn't a 'good guy.' Desperate, they decide to break Artyomik's arm to get a six-month medical deferment. After the friends fail to break it despite painful attempts, they call their neighbor Vardan, a professional butcher. Vardan examines the arm like a piece of meat, criticizes the 'quality' of the bruised flesh, and finally delivers a professional blow. The scene shifts to a corridor where Artyomik appears with his arm in a sling. He reveals the irony: the military doctors granted him a full exemption not because of the broken arm, but because he has chronic kidney disease. Vardan, outraged that they wasted a perfectly good arm without checking his health first, chases the group away in frustration.
catchphrases: Մինակ ջարդո՞ւմ եմ, թե աղում էլ եմ։
